session_narrative: Doubles. Won 6-4, 7-5. Serve felt slow the whole time, kept telling Rhea I was struggling with it. Three double faults total, all second-set. First serve percentage looked reasonable, I stopped tracking mid-match. Rhea won us the second set with her poaching. My best contribution was two returns of serve down the middle that they didn't handle.
take_away: Won but the serve was a drag on the whole match. Feels slow. Not sure the new toss is worth it.
